Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stake Lowered by Marcus Capital LLC Posted by Paula Ricardo | Mar 20th, 2018 
Marcus Capital LLC lowered its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 33.2% during the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 9,667 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 4,808 shares during the period. Apple comprises 2.1% of Marcus Capital LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 22nd biggest position. Marcus Capital LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,490,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). 
A number of other hedge funds also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Schnieders Capital Management LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.6% in the 2nd quarter. Schnieders Capital Management LLC now owns 41,583 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,989,000 after acquiring an additional 1,435 shares during the last quarter. DT Investment Partners LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 46.3% in the 2nd quarter. DT Investment Partners LLC now owns 2,684 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $387,000 after acquiring an additional 850 shares during the last quarter. Alpha Cubed Investments LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 15.6% in the 2nd quarter. Alpha Cubed Investments LLC now owns 231,712 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $33,371,000 after acquiring an additional 31,227 shares during the last quarter. Eagle Global Advisors LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.6% in the 2nd quarter. Eagle Global Advisors LLC now owns 210,143 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $30,265,000 after acquiring an additional 3,340 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Probity Advisors Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.7% in the 2nd quarter. Probity Advisors Inc. now owns 4,789 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $690,000 after acquiring an additional 80 shares during the last quarter. 61.33% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. A number of research analysts have recently commented on the company. Vetr downgraded Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $187.18 price objective on the stock. in a report on Wednesday, February 14th. UBS set a $190.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, December 4th. Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price objective on the stock in a report on Thursday, January 18th. Rosenblatt Securities restated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday. Finally, Piper Jaffray Companies restated a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.53. 
Apple ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded down $0.06 during trading on Tuesday, reaching $175.24. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 19,602,195 shares, compared to its average volume of 37,462,656. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The stock has a market capitalization of $903,275.88, a P/E ratio of 18.01, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.34 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a one year low of $138.62 and a one year high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link . Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
